prompt: Analyze all supplied business documents and identify exactly three unresolved actions. Build reports/unresolved_actions.json with action, owner, deadline, priority, source_doc and evidence_quote for every entry. Exclude completed or merely tentative actions, resolve duplicates, and mark uncertainty instead of inventing facts.

Compare previous.md, current.md and next_draft.md. Report only substantive changes, covering additions, removals, changed rules and unchanged sections, with file:line citations and operator impact. Save reports/procedure_diff.md and reports/procedure_diff.json.

Determine which workflow is authoritative across the supplied procedures and meeting notes. Build reports/claim_evidence.json with claim, source_doc, evidence_quote and contradicting_claims; save reports/evidence_review.md; explicitly name the authoritative source, criteria and uncertainty. Do not invent evidence.
